title: Checkpoint: shape dispatch
prompt: Complete `int totalArea(Shape[] shapes)`: sum every shape's area() via dispatch and round DOWN to an int. Square chains through Rect. One loop, one accumulator, zero instanceof — dispatch does the branching.

tests.name: total via dispatch
tests.hint: int total = 0; for each: total += s.area(); return total; — 16.5 would truncate, but our values are whole.
